youtube.name: Body of Our Dreams
youtube.description:
Your dream body. Your real life.

New to fitness, with a week that's already full? We share science-backed advice on training, food, movement and recovery that you can put to use.

This started when a friend said she wanted the "body of her dreams" while juggling a busy life. We started joking about it, but we meant it too. We wanted to look and feel better without making fitness our whole lives.

Each video explains one thing and gives you something to try. We link the research and say when the answer isn't clear.

Use these videos to learn and ask better questions. They aren't a personal training or nutrition plan.
